status: Exploratory expansion after near_precursor-v1 had insufficient calibration events. Earlier study remains unchanged. Historical evidence is not prospective validation.
sampling: Hourly decisions using only closed15min bars and derivatives timestamp+15min. Entry proxy next15min open; report explicit execution limitations and10/20bps cost sensitivities, never change underlying5%/10% targets.
candidate: Before a large move: absolute trailing1h return<1% and absolute trailing4h return<2%. Report coverage lost to this gate; no threshold tuning.
splits: Last270complete days split into3 chronological90day test blocks. Each has immediately previous90day calibration and previous360day training. Purge73h labels at ends of train/cal/test; leave72h embargo at beginnings of calibration/test. No shuffled split or test-based selection.
labels: Separate direct first-touch5%/10% within24h/72h from precursor detection. Record time to touch and maximum adverse excursion until touch/horizon; intrabar order ambiguity retained. Report adverse barrier2%/3%/5% sensitivity without interpreting as user's actual stops. Censored outcomes unknown.
onsets: Close-only directional-change zigzag5%/10%: alternating confirmed upward/downward legs, retrospectively anchored at previous extremal close. Descriptive onset cases and15..60min pre-onset labels; this hindsight anchor is never an input feature. Report event recall and pre-onset alert precision separately from eventual target-touch rate.
features: Past price returns, turnover build/acceleration, realized volatility/range compression, candle wick balance, trend efficiency, BTC/ETH excess returns/market context. Paired additions: NEAR OI1h/4h/24h, last settled funding and lagged mark/trade basis. No buy/sell flow, historical orderbook or liquidation inference from candles.
models: StandardScaler+L2 logistic C1; HistGradientBoosting max_iter100,max_leaf_nodes7,learning_rate0.05,l2_regularization1,early_stoppingFalse,random_state17. Compare price-only and price+derivatives on identical complete rows. Feature groups fixed; no model hyperparameter search.
calibration: Threshold candidates at calibration score quantiles80/90/95/97.5/99%.6h chronological cooldown per direction. Select maximum exact95% precision lower bound with>=20 calibration alerts; ties prefer more alerts. Precursor models additionally need>=20 reachable train events and>=5 reachable calibration events. Freeze each model/threshold before reading its test results.
baselines: Scheduled quiet candidates with6h cooldown; price-momentum score calibrated using identical threshold selection; matched-week random alert timing with same counts and6h spacing. Report unequal alert-budget comparisons explicitly.
uncertainty: Exact binomial CI plus7day block bootstrap, per-fold consistency, target/move definition sensitivity, direction-specific metrics and extreme-event dependence. Multiple explored models are not independent confirmations. Any80% claim requires>=100 alerts,>=8weeks,>=10% onset recall and block95% lower bound>=80% in future prospective data.
transfer: SUI/APT/SEI were selected after observing recent history. Their historical transfer analysis is exploratory and cannot count as independent unbiased validation.
deployment: Do not automatically deploy any backtest winner. Publish failures and support limits. Freeze a future prospective protocol before promotion.
